description: The files attached to a workbook for its runs to read and cite. Lists them; `add_name` with `add_content_base64` attaches one; `remove` takes one off.

add_name.description: The name of a file to attach, e.g. 'Q3 board pack.pdf'.

remove.description: The name of an attached file to take off.

name: attachments
title: A workbook's attached files
